race.description: Redmond's Pet & Livestock Supplies F&M Hcp (58)
race.comment: FAR CRY (5) gets the nod after going within a length at this track on soft ground last start in BM55 company, and that run looks the clearest current reference. Her Ipswich BM65 run two back was plain, but she was unwanted there and returned to far better form under today's more familiar conditions. OH PRETTY EMMA (6) was beaten as favourite first-up, yet she came from a long way back after a slow start and has already won at this track and distance. Key runner. SHEDRIVESABENTLEY (4) has not been far away, with excuses at this venue two starts back and a 1.5kg claim to help, so she remains a genuine minor-winning chance if the 1400m suits. KEY COMPONENT (8) picked up well for fourth at Ipswich fresh and should improve second-up. Can threaten.
